name: accordion
description: A named group of collapsible sections, each with a heading and a page content slot. All sections start closed. More than one section can be open at a time.

parts.name: details
parts.description: Control and technical details of a refusal.

parts.name: heading
parts.description: Heading that contains the section button.

parts.name: panel
parts.description: Container for page content. An expanded section shows its panel.

parts.name: toggle
parts.description: Button that expands or collapses its section.
